summary: Restored the protected W13 production migration-before-deployment workflow and added workflow contract coverage.

produces.name: protected production workflow
produces.note: Pushes only main, uses the production environment and serialized concurrency, checks out github.sha, builds without secrets, runs the exact migration wrapper, then requests the deploy hook only after success.

produces.name: production workflow contract tests
produces.note: Covers trigger, environment, identity variables, immutable checkout, protected secret names, ordering, and forbidden token or direct migration paths.

produces.name: migration wrapper checker support
produces.note: The production contract recognizes the mandated node --import tsx wrapper command.

next: T4 can document the exact wrapper command, workflow secret names, and the owner-side Vercel Git auto-deploy-disabled evidence gate.

deviations.what: The shared T2 checker regex did not recognize the mandated node --import tsx wrapper form.
deviations.why: The workflow contract otherwise rejected the exact command required by T3, so its matcher was extended narrowly to accept the required form.
